subtasks.title: Extend UniqueLprCaseClaimsQuery additively with the pre-claim rate methods (TDD: new query test first)
subtasks.approach: Q4's answer, implemented so that DEV-2463's merged contract cannot move. Write tests/Feature/Clickhouse/UniqueScansToCaseClaimsQueryTest.php FIRST -- a NEW file, so DEV-2463's UniqueLprCaseClaimsQueryTest.php stays byte-for-byte unmodified as the Q4 constraint requires -- then add to the query class: two new public statics, one new private SQL branch, and a clarityDb() helper. Strict additivity is mechanical, not aspirational: the hotlist_id projection, the raw `be.ts AS ts` projection and the hits_cold CTE are ALL conditional on a new `$withRate` flag defaulting to false, so window() and monthlySeries() emit byte-identical SQL and byte-identical {all_claims, successful, deduped} arrays. The join-miss guard from constraint 1 is the whole point of the node: hits_cold.scanned_at is non-Nullable DateTime and join_use_nulls defaults to 0, so a LEFT JOIN miss fills 1970-01-01, which is earlier than every claim ts -- the naive predicate counts all 370 hitless orders as pre-claim and inflates 96.6% to 99.7% silently. Guard with an explicit `s.hotlist_id != 0` term ANDed into the uniqExactIf condition (hits_cold.hotlist_id is Int64 non-Nullable so a miss fills 0, and derivation_log entry 5 measured zero successful claims with hotlist_id = 0 in the window, so 0 is a safe sentinel). Every aggregate is uniqExact -- hits_cold measures 1.543x over on this population via bare count() and FINAL does not fix it because hit_created_at is mutable and in the sort key. Read hits_cold, never hits_hot (its ~90-day TTL would truncate a metric that can span years). _peerdb_is_deleted = 0 on both hits_cold and public_billing_events; public_orgs and public_api_keys FINAL. Reject insightlpr on both org sides; NEVER filter titlemax. The rate itself is computed in PHP, not SQL -- `$denom > 0 ? round($num / $denom * 100, 1) : 0.0` -- because ClickHouse integer division by zero yields inf/nan and Q3 requires a clean 0.0. No try/catch anywhere: propagate Throwable, matching the class's existing deliberate stance (:86-88), because a genuine zero is a normal reading for ~83% of orgs.

subtasks.title: Card data seams: float-safe getCardRate(), 13-month UTC rate series, percentage description and UTC label axis
subtasks.approach: Fill the stub's seams in place. Constraint 2 is the shape of the whole node: DashboardWidget declares getCardTotal(): int (:321), currentPeriodTotal(): int (:344) and getRangeTotal(string, string): int (:367), so PHP fatals at class-load on an int->float widening and using them unwidened truncates 96.6 to 96 or 0. The rate is therefore computed end-to-end inside the card's own getCardRate(): float for EVERY date option, and the surviving int stubs are left returning 0 with a docblock saying nothing routes through them -- pinned, not merely asserted, by the WindowSeamTest this node writes first. Mirror the shipped sibling UniqueLprCaseClaims for everything already solved there: this_month/last_month come free from the already-cached 13-month series (no extra query, exactly as getCardTotal() at :321-333 does for integer cards) while today/last_7d resolve through a single windowWithPreClaimScans() call, so no filter state can trigger more than one round trip -- AC-4. Split the call from the stage selection into fetchWindowRate()/runWindowRateQuery() seams, copying UniqueLprCaseClaims.php:339-355, because DEV-2463's own history shows a ['deduped'] -> ['successful'] mutant survived 35 tests until that split existed. getMonthlyData() returns 13 per-month RATE floats from ONE monthlySeriesWithPreClaimScans() call under Cache::flexible([3600, 86400]) with the UTC month IN the cache key (the sibling's :127-137 note: keyed only on the org, a series computed at 23:55 on the last UTC day of a month stays 'fresh' into the next one and the ?? 0 fabricates a zero indistinguishable from a real one). A rate series is not summable, so nothing may aggregate these buckets -- chartSeries() already casts each bucket to float and passes it through unchanged (BuildsDateFilterChartSeries.php:47-63), so the sparkline machinery needs no change. Because the month axis is UTC, the LABEL axis must co-vary: override getGraphLabels() and getHighlightedMonthsFromFilter() to UTC exactly as the sibling does at :234-254, or a Chicago viewer in the first 5-6 hours of a UTC month sees every bar labelled one month early. Copy the sibling's cold-path herd guard (heldFlexible + COLD_BLOCK_SECONDS/COLD_LOCK_SECONDS/REFRESH_LOCK_SECONDS + flexibleCreatedKey) and its getCacheTTL() MIN_TTL_SECONDS floor: this query is the sibling's ~1.83GB scan PLUS a hits_cold join, so it is strictly worse than the 9.3s contended p99 those constants were sized against, and the 10s impersonator TTL collapse cannot be honoured. This is deliberate duplication -- extracting a shared trait would mean editing UniqueLprCaseClaims itself, widening the t2 blast radius for no correctness gain; docblock it and note DEV-2464 as the third caller that should trigger the extraction. Keep toStat() exactly as the stub has it (number_format(getCardRate(), 1).'%'). Do NOT add canViewCardData() here -- that is t5, deliberately isolated so this node carries no blast-radius tag. Delete the stub docblock's 'The card ticket replaces the data methods in place and removes this note.' line.
